title: Verify nonthermal χ1/χ2–SM finite-vector 5D weak CI; derive paired strong Cχ(p), Cℓ(k) Pauli 2→2 with energy/number/entropy closure
objective: Real neutral φ Yukawa qχ1=qχ2 vector model requires BOTH χ species to scatter with e±/ν. Prior full finite-mV 5D heat could only use prescribed thermal FD. Now new function accepts arbitrary isotropic nonthermal fχ(E),fℓ(ω), exact Pauli forward/reverse and finite mℓ, with Qχ=-Qℓ and nonnegative entropy. Same-temperature FD with nonzero independent chemical µ species must be exact fixed point. Benchmark Mχ1=.1 and Mχ2=.02 under synthetic nonthermal f only; no actual χ2 abundance or physical γel. Check new full Scientific CI, then implement independently matched mode-resolved relativistic strong Cχ(p), Cℓ(k) on physically weighted grids for BOTH χ1+χ2+e±/ν channels. Show full Nχ,Nℓ conservation, Qchi+Qlep=0 and entropy on same finite measure, q/angle/cutoff convergence (>=3 resolutions), real SM/eγν bath before moving to Yukawa φ and FRW. If microphysical UV completion invalid, revise model with proofs, not BGK substitution.
prerequisites: Read current task-aware AGENTS/PROJECT_MAP, plans/RESEARCH_ROADMAP_DETAIL.md, kinetics/RESEARCH_GUARDRAILS and specialised GOAL/CONTINUOUS-RESEARCH-SPEC; verify PR #1 draft and current HEAD.

Check actual GitHub Actions Scientific verification for new nonthermal_chi_lepton_5d_weak.py tests; previous Strang temporal CI #45015624238 passed on b820abf, prior exact Strang CI #45015296472 passed.

Run python -m pytest -q tests/test_nonthermal_chi_lepton_5d_weak.py tests/test_finite_mediator_5d_adaptive_reference.py tests/test_chi2_lepton_heat_gate.py; python -m kinetics.nonthermal_chi_lepton_5d_weak.

Read NONTHERMAL-CHI-LEPTON-5D-WEAK-AUDIT.md and JSON, compare specialized FD subset with existing full_heat(...polar='cosine') on matched nrad4,nmu4,nphi12,nang12,cut12 and independent E/entropy formulas; do not claim full strong operator.
experiments: Build conservative paired χ and SM-lepton strong mode sources from exactly same χℓ2→2 quantum event measure with finite mV propagator. Include Fermi 0<=f<=1, signed number densities, exact energy/entropy and independent incoming 5D weak reference; test equilibrium at common T and independent μχ/μℓ.

Numerically converge radial incoming, CM angular, azimuth, qmax/UV tail for Mchi1=.1,Mchi2=.02, mℓ=0 and finite electron mass and at least two nonthermal f spectra; test χ2 actual abundance as a separate dynamic variable, not hardcoded daughter FD.

Integrate full finite-SM e±γν weak chemistry and on-shell Zprime channels, original χ1↔χ2+86eV φ Bose/Pauli and FRW H with realistic gauge mass/coupling/BBN limits; only then physical Γelastic, f(q), ΩDM/BEC/CLASS.
constraints: Public research branch and draft PR only; no force-push or merge main, no Computer Use/user PC, small GitHub CI and permanent evidence archive, no unsupported physical DM claims.
